what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Eritrea in Israel: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 6693 Eritrean asylum seekers in Israel, 5.7% of all asylum seekers from Eritrea.
Refugees from Eritrea, a separate group, live mostly in Ethiopia, Sudan, Germany and Switzerland.

why.text: UCDP records interstate armed conflicts between Eritrea and Ethiopia from 1998 to 2000 and in 2016, and between Djibouti and Eritrea in 2008.
It also records armed conflict over the government of Eritrea in 1997, 1999 and 2003.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2000 at 30 asylum seekers, and the figure was at its highest, 12003, at the end of 2020.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2018 to 2025, and the figure was lower by 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Israel.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Israel only.
